In detail

Italian press coverage of Venice's historic-center Municipalità is dominated by one very well-documented issue: pickpocketing and petty theft targeting tourists in the most crowded zones — Piazza San Marco, the Rialto Bridge/market area, the Accademia bridge, and the corridor between the train station and Cannaregio/Strada Nova. Il Gazzettino and La Nuova Venezia have run repeated 2024-2025 stories on organized pickpocket crews (including one alley nicknamed "Calle Pickpocket"), gondoliers physically intervening to stop thieves, and municipal figures citing roughly 50-130 pickpockets stopped by local police within months in 2025. There are also documented, if less frequent, muggings/assaults on tourists (a bag-snatching that hospitalized a victim with concussion in September 2024, an aggression near Rialto, a pickpocket who beat a victim who caught her) and a June 2026 ANSA report on unofficial "porters" arrested for extortion/threats against tourists at the station. A September 2025 Sky TG24 report described Jewish tourists verbally and physically harassed. Classic overcharging scams (inflated restaurant bills) are also frequently reported. Separately, Cannaregio (especially near the station) has seen residents protest with anti-drug-dealing banners, prefecture-ordered interforze patrols, and police drug seizures through 2025; nearby Fondamenta della Misericordia has prompted bar-hour ordinances over rowdy nightlife noise. No credible, dated reporting ties any of this to Giudecca, Murano or Burano beyond isolated shop burglaries (a Murano glass-shop safe-crack, an attempted Burano jewelry-store theft) — these islands show no documented pattern of tourist-directed crime and default to no particular concern. Violent crime overall remains rare; Venice's international reputation as a very safe destination is intact, though petty theft is genuinely common enough in the tourist core to warrant caution both day and night. Sources checked: Il Gazzettino (ilgazzettino.it); La Nuova Venezia (nuovavenezia.it); VeneziaToday (veneziatoday.it); ANSA Veneto (ansa.it); Sky TG24 (tg24.sky.it); Comune di Venezia - Live (live.comune.venezia.it); TgCom24 Mediaset (tgcom24.mediaset.it); La Piazza Web (lapiazzaweb.it).
